# Default exclusions

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-exclusions-doc.sh from bin/ziproj. Do not edit by hand: run `make docs`. -->

These rules always apply, whether a file is tracked by git or not, at any depth in the project.
`*` matches any characters, including `/`. Add your own rules with `-x` or an
[ignore file](configuration.md#ignore-files).

## Files that hold secrets

Matched in any letter case: `.ENV` and `Server.PEM` are excluded too, since the default macOS file system treats them as the same names.

`.env`, `.env.*`, `*.env`, `.envrc`, `.dev.vars`, `.netrc`, `.npmrc`, `.yarnrc.yml`, `.pypirc`, `.pgpass`, `.git-credentials`, `.htpasswd`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.p8`, `*.p12`, `*.pfx`, `*.cer`, `*.crt`, `*.der`, `*.csr`, `*.certSigningRequest`, `*.mobileprovision`, `*.provisionprofile`, `*.jks`, `*.keystore`, `*.jwks`, `*.ppk`, `*.gpg`, `*.kdbx`, `*.har`, `id_rsa*`, `id_dsa*`, `id_ecdsa*`, `id_ed25519*`, `GoogleService-Info*.plist`, `google-services.json`, `*service-account*.json`, `*service_account*.json`, `*-adminsdk-*.json`, `client_secret*.json`, `credentials.json`, `[Ss]ecret.*`, `[Ss]ecrets.*`, `*.secret`, `*.secrets`, `local.properties`, `keystore.properties`, `master.key`, `*.tfvars`, `*.tfstate`, `*.tfstate.*`, `*.sqlite`, `*.sqlite3`, `*.sqlite-*`, `*.db`, `*.db-*`, `*.realm`, `*.dump`

## Folders that hold secrets

Excluded with everything inside them, in any letter case.

`.ssh`, `.aws`, `.gnupg`, `.docker`, `.kube`, `.azure`, `.keystore`, `secrets`, `.secrets`

## Dead weight: files

OS litter, logs, compiled objects, app packages and archives.

`.DS_Store`, `._*`, `Thumbs.db`, `*.log`, `*.swp`, `*.swo`, `*~`, `*.orig`, `*.xcuserstate`, `*.iml`, `*.pyc`, `*.pyo`, `*.class`, `*.o`, `*.tsbuildinfo`, `.eslintcache`, `*.ipa`, `*.apk`, `*.aab`, `*.zip`, `*.tar`, `*.tar.gz`, `*.tgz`, `*.7z`, `*.rar`

## Dead weight: folders

Version control data, dependencies, build output and caches, excluded with everything inside them. These names are case-sensitive, so a source folder called `Build` is kept.

`.git`, `.svn`, `.hg`, `.build`, `.swiftpm`, `DerivedData`, `Derived`, `xcuserdata`, `Pods`, `Carthage/Build`, `*.xcarchive`, `*.xcresult`, `*.dSYM`, `*.app`, `fastlane/test_output`, `fastlane/screenshots`, `build`, `.gradle`, `.kotlin`, `.cxx`, `.externalNativeBuild`, `.idea`, `captures`, `node_modules`, `.npm`, `.pnpm-store`, `dist`, `.next`, `.nuxt`, `.svelte-kit`, `.output`, `.turbo`, `.vercel`, `.netlify`, `.parcel-cache`, `.cache`, `coverage`, `.nyc_output`, `.expo`, `__pycache__`, `.venv`, `venv`, `.mypy_cache`, `.pytest_cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.tox`, `*.egg-info`, `target`, `.terraform`, `.serverless`

## AI mode (`-a`)

These extensions are also excluded with `-a`, in any letter case (`.PNG` as well as `.png`).

`png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `gif`, `webp`, `heic`, `heif`, `tif`, `tiff`, `bmp`, `ico`, `icns`, `pdf`, `ttf`, `otf`, `woff`, `woff2`, `mp4`, `mov`, `m4v`, `webm`, `avi`, `mp3`, `m4a`, `aac`, `wav`, `aif`, `aiff`, `caf`, `psd`, `sketch`, `fig`
